findings.failureScenario: `cargo xtask` usage and crates/codecs/tests/corpus.rs both state that `cargo xtask corpus --download` fetches PngSuite into corpus/, but cmd_corpus only iterates RAW_SAMPLES into corpus/raw. corpus/pngsuite is never populated, so corpus_pngsuite always prints 'skip: ... absent' and returns; developers and CI believe PNG conformance coverage exists when it never runs.
findings.action: Either add PngSuite (pinned URL + sha256) to the corpus download into corpus/pngsuite, or remove the PngSuite claim from the USAGE text and the corpus.rs module doc and document how corpus/pngsuite is obtained.

findings.failureScenario: docs/sony-lens-corrections.md says the current `cargo xtask corpus --download` manifest holds 23 Sony samples across 17 bodies and that all of them are checked by sony_embedded_distortion_is_limited_to_validated_models. RAW_SAMPLES now also pins ILCE-7CM2 (2 files, issue #697) and ILCE-7RM6 ARW6 (2 files): 27 Sony files across 19 bodies. The 4 newer files are absent from the model-boundary test list, so the documented guarantee that every Sony corpus file is checked against the distortion model boundary is false for those bodies.
findings.action: Update the Sony doc counts/table to the current manifest, and add the ILCE-7CM2 and ILCE-7RM6 samples (expected 0 warps) to sony_embedded_distortion_is_limited_to_validated_models, or state explicitly why they are excluded.

findings.failureScenario: xtask usage, the `layers` report header and the unregistered-crate violation message all direct the reader to plan/architecture.md §3, but plan/ is git-ignored and docs/architecture.md states that file is local-only. A contributor on a fresh clone who hits 'register it in xtask/src/layers.rs TABLE (see plan/architecture.md §3)' finds no such file; the tracked rules live in docs/architecture.md '## Layers'.
findings.action: Point the xtask USAGE, cmd_layers header and layers.rs messages at docs/architecture.md#layers (the tracked document).

findings.failureScenario: main dispatches `cargo xtask version [set X.Y.Z]` (the documented single source of truth for the workspace version used by packaging), but USAGE lists no `version` command, so `cargo xtask help` hides the version-bump entry point.
findings.action: Add `version [set X.Y.Z[-pre]]` to the USAGE command list.

findings.failureScenario: The module doc says tests_masking.rs holds headless tests of the Masking and Remove tools, but it also holds smart-album editor, slideshow, Local folder tree, external-editor, soft-proofing and 100k-grid performance tests. A developer changing those features searches the appropriately named modules, misses these regression tests, and the doc misdirects test ownership.
findings.action: Move the unrelated tests into modules named for their features, or widen the module doc to describe what the file actually covers.
